name: Marvel Rivals
native_kbm_note: The PS5 version is controller-only. In January 2025 NetEase said console players who use keyboard/mouse adapters (XIM, Cronus Zen, Titan Two, KayMander, Brook and 'any similar emulation tool') will be penalized, up to permanent suspension (gfinityesports, esports.gg). This bridge counts as such an adapter, so there is a real ban risk in online play.
notes: PC keys: magicgameworld + boosting-ground (both agree). PS5 sourced only loosely: R2 primary attack, Square reload, R3 melee, Triangle ultimate, Cross jump and L1 secondary ability come from bittopup (low-quality guide); D-pad Up hero profile / D-pad Right Chrono Vision from boosting-ground and esports.gg. UNVERIFIED (inferred from the Overwatch-style layout and earlier draft; bittopup contradicts it): secondary attack L2, Ability 1 (E) R1, Ability 3 (F) Circle (techradar only says Circle is used for abilities on some heroes), scoreboard Touchpad. Abilities vary per hero, but the slots (E / Shift / F / Q) are shared; console allows per-hero remaps. Omitted, PS5 button unknown: team-ups Z/X/C, descend (LCtrl), change hero (H), weapons 1/2, ping (D-pad Down on PS5, but the PC key is unsourced).
